name: What are the benefits of hiring a general contractor for a kitchen upgrade?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of hiring a general contractor for a kitchen upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a general contractor for your kitchen upgrade provides a single point of contact responsible for overseeing the entire project. This includes managing subcontractors (plumbers, electricians, carpenters), coordinating schedules, handling material procurement, and ensuring quality control. A general contractor streamlines the process, ensures compliance with building codes, and keeps the project on budget and schedule, reducing stress and potential issues for the homeowner.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor manages all aspects of a kitchen upgrade, including subcontractors, scheduling, materials, and quality control, ensuring a smoother process.
